summary: Complete baseline, decisions, package-local build baseline, trust model and authorization before migrating generic V3 capability and then the V3_ifx overlay, using independently verifiable and reversible checkpoints as PR units.
rationale: User answer to Plan 06 D7 and the review 6.8 ordering. Current Diff protection blocks deletes and moves under docs/guards until the authorization mechanism exists, and switching V3_ifx to V3 before upstreaming hardening would regress security. One structure is designed for V3 and V3_ifx; IFX needs enter V3 when generalizable. Checkpoints are defined in the formal plan pair 20260916-v3-stage-oriented-package-refactor. Plan 06 sections 14 and 17 D7.
